name: Love Hurts
summary: Gan'rul sends you to find Magar along Orgrimmar's main drag. His longing for Krilge may point to the object needed to lure an incubus into the world.

sections.title: Magar's Search
sections.body: Magar lives east of the Cleft of Shadow. He longs for Krilge's return and will ask you to search for something precious. Bring that object to Gan'rul, who needs an item of love and devotion to summon an incubus.

faq.answer: Magar lives along Orgrimmar's main drag and longs for the return of Krilge.
Krilge is Magar's mate, whose return he longs for.
An incubus is a male sayaad, described as profoundly evil and single-minded.
Gan'rul needs an item that represents great love and devotion to lure an incubus into the world.
Magar lives east of the Cleft of Shadow, along Orgrimmar's main drag.
